entries.note: Marcus says stakeholders 'will quickly emerge victorious'; the normalization weakens that prediction to 'very likely.' The parenthetical qualifies whether victory had already occurred.
The potential harm is explicitly hedged and conditional. 'Original safety mission' narrows the original mission of ensuring safe AGI that benefits all humanity.
Marcus gives a negative appraisal without predicting a particular outcome. The normalization narrows 'none of this' to a stakeholder victory and supplies safety as the specific concern.
